meta.name: design-system-compliance
meta.description: Check that the UI you actually rendered uses the design system, by reading computed styles in the running app against the project's design tokens. Catches hardcoded hex colors, off-palette backgrounds, invisible or unusable controls, and animations that never ran. Use after building or restyling a component, when a design review is wanted, when a UI looks slightly off but nobody can say why, or when a design system exists and nothing checks whether the code follows it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照设计规范检查页面真实渲染样式,揪出跑偏的颜色与失效的控件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你已有设计规范,却没人检查代码是否真的照着用
copy.tagline_en: Check rendered UI against your design tokens to flag off-palette colors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a design system and nothing verifies the code follows it

howto.what: 它会读取运行中页面的实际计算样式,和项目里的设计令牌逐一比对,报出硬编码色值、脱离调色板的背景、被遮挡或 0×0 的不可用控件,以及从未运行的动画,并给出对应的 file:line。
howto.when: 在构建或改完组件样式之后、有人要做设计评审、或 UI 看着不对却说不出原因时触发。

say.text: 检查这个按钮的实际计算样式是否符合设计令牌
say.note: 返回 offTheme、命中的颜色令牌和 file:line

say.text: 这个控件是不是被遮挡或尺寸为 0,点不了?
say.note: 读 occluded 和 box 字段判断

say.text: 列出最近跑过的动画,确认新加动效真的执行了
say.note: 调 reticle_animations 看运行与完成记录

howto.what_en: It reads computed styles in the running app, compares them to the project's design tokens, and reports hardcoded colors, off-palette backgrounds, occluded or 0×0 controls, and animations that never ran, each with a file:line.
howto.when_en: Use after building or restyling a component, when a design review is wanted, or when a UI looks slightly off but nobody can say why.

say_en.text: Check whether this button's computed styles match the design tokens
say_en.note: Returns offTheme, matched color tokens, and file:line

say_en.text: Is this control occluded or 0×0, so nobody can click it?
say_en.note: Reads the occluded and box fields

say_en.text: List recent animations to confirm the new motion actually ran
say_en.note: Calls reticle_animations for running and completed ones
